Quests.LongInfo:
Find the thief

Sarah recently had one of her custom-built suits of armor stolen from her. The thief was last seen in the underground.

Mission Objective:
Locate the thief and recover the DNA-Locked Armor.

Deliver DNA-Locked Armor to Sarah Greene

You have found the stolen suit of armor.


Return the DNA-Locked Armor to Sarah Greene.

Speak to Vernon Godfray

Identity Crisis:
In order to leave Arete Landing and become a citizen of Rubi-Ka, you need an identity. Your mission is to create a fake ID Card to you can leave this place..

Sarah told you to speak to Vernon Godfray, a local hacker, who should be able to help with aquiring more parts needed for your ID card.

Mission Objective:
Talk to Vernon Godfray.

Talk to Stan Goodman

Identity Crisis:

Alex told you to go talk to Stan Goodman, a local 'purveyer of recently used merchandise'. He should be able to help with aquiring more parts for your ID card.

Mission Objective:

Buy a Lockpick

Stan told you to Pick the Lock on the Strongbox in the Merchant's Storage undetected, but in order to do so you need to buy a Lock Pick.

Mission Objective:
Find the ICC Tech Supplies vending machine and buy a Lock Pick.

Quests.LongInfo:
Take the contents of the Strongbox

Stan told you to Pick the Lock on the Strongbox in the Merchant's Storage undetetected. Now that you have bought a Lock Pick, this should be an easy task.

Mission Objective:
Pick up (Left Click) your Lock Pick from your inventory and drop it (Left Click) on the Merchant's Strongbox.

Deliver Antonio's Adaptation Factory to Stan Goodman.

Stan told you to Pick the Lock on the Strongbox in the Merchant's Storage undetetected. Now that you have found Antonio's Adaptation Factory, bring it back to Stan.

Mission Objective:
Bring Antonio's Adaptation Factory to Stan Goodman.

Talk to Sarah Greene

Buy some Nano Programs

Stanley Goodman told you to go talk to Marco Spida to buy a Nanoprogram Container.

Mission Objective: Talk to Marco Spida and buy a Nanoprogram Container for your profession. Open the Container to complete your mission.
